name: tiktok-live-game-project
description: TikTok LIVE comment viewer với NestJS và Next.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tiktok-live/backend" "npm run dev -w @tiktok-live/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tiktok-live/backend && npm run build -w @tiktok-live/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @tiktok-live/backend" "npm run start -w @tiktok-live/frontend"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w @tiktok-live/backend && npm run typecheck -w @tiktok-live/frontend
